speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis (Cradle Cap). The greasy yellow scales and family history of psoriasis can be confusing, but the specific "greasy" nature of the scales and the seasonal worsening in a 3-month-old are classic for seborrheic dermatitis. I recommend avoiding harsh shampoos and using mild emollients; please monitor if it spreads to the ears or eyebrows.
